components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Lime-filled primary action button with signature glow shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C8F169; color: #181A1B; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -3px rgba(200,241,105,0.3); transition: background 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9FBF3E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C8F169; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inverse Button
components.description: Charcoal-filled secondary action button, paired beside a primary lime button.
components.css: .ds-btn-inverse { background: #181A1B; color: #F7F7F2; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-inverse:hover { background: #27272A; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis tertiary action on a recessed neutral fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #F4F4F5; color: #3F3F46; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #E4E4E7; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed-surface input with lime focus ring, no border color shift.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; background: rgba(250,250,250,0.6); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #181A1B; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A1A1AA; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #C8F169; }

components.name: Positive Badge
components.description: Pill tag for recognition, positive deltas, and settled/on-shift status.
components.css: .ds-badge-positive { display: inline-block; background: #F4FBE6; color: #6B8429; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #DCF0A3; }

components.name: Neutral Badge
components.css: .ds-badge-neutral { display: inline-block; background: #F4F4F5; color: #71717A; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: KPI tile: label + delta pill on top row, large value, muted caption.
components.html:
Total Tips (7d)+18.4%
$3,420.50
428 customer tips processed
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(228,228,231,0.8); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #71717A; } .ds-card-value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: #181A1B; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-card-caption { font-size: 11px; color: #A1A1AA; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Active/inactive sidebar navigation link with lime-tinted active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #52525B; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #F4F4F5; color: #181A1B; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #F4FBE6; color: #6B8429; }

components.name: Device Frame
components.description: Rounded phone-frame container used to present the customer tipping flow.
components.css: .ds-device-frame { width: 100%; max-width: 390px; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 40px; border: 1px solid rgba(228,228,231,0.8); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); overflow: hidden; min-height: 640px; } .ds-device-screen { padding: 24px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #181A1B; }

components.name: Icon Badge
components.description: lucide-react icon (stroke-width 2) paired with a short label, replacing the mockups' emoji tags.

narrative.overview:
Delitip's visual world reads like an honest financial record, not a generic tipping widget. Every surface — the customer's phone screen, the employee's payout card, the owner's dashboard — is built to make one thing visible at a glance: exactly where the money went, and to whom. Receipts carry reference numbers. Dashboards pair every stat with a time window and a sample size. Settlement states ("Settled", "On Shift", "100% Direct") are stated, not implied.

The palette does the heavy lifting: a near-black ink surface for anything serious (the business's own brand, security, payouts) against a single electric-lime accent that appears only where something good is happening — an active state, a rising number, a completed action. Rounded, generous geometry (16-40px radii, phone-frame device mockups) keeps the fintech confidence from feeling cold or corporate; nothing in the system uses a hard, square corner.

Confirmed anti-reference: this is not playful or gamified fintech. Recognition moments (compliment tags, badges) stay warm, but they use icon-based tags rather than emoji, and nothing about money, security, or settlement status softens into cuteness.

Implementation: built on shadcn/ui (Base UI primitives) over Tailwind v4, with lucide-react as the icon set. globals.css carries this palette as two layers: every color above is a static Tailwind primitive (--color-electric-lime, --color-brand-700, --color-ink-charcoal, --color-signal-red, etc.), directly usable as utilities. shadcn's semantic roles (--background, --primary, --destructive) reference those primitives via var() rather than repeating literal hex, so light/dark mode and any future re-theming only touch one source of truth. --radius is set to 1rem so shadcn's derived radius scale lines up with this document's Shapes scale.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, used sparingly: lime marks "this is active / this is good," never a background fill for large surfaces.
Money and status are always stated exactly — amount, timestamp, reference ID — never rounded or implied.
Flat, bordered surfaces in light mode; ambient lime glow (not shadow) for depth on dark surfaces.
Aggressively rounded geometry throughout — no sharp corners anywhere in the system.
A recurring "phone-frame" device mockup is the system's signature way of showing the customer experience inside a business or marketing surface.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime never fills a large surface. It marks a button, a selected state, a positive delta, or a single glow — never a section background.

rules.name: The Exact-Money Rule
rules.body: Any figure tied to a transaction (tip amount, payout, fee) is rendered in full precision with its currency symbol — never rounded, abbreviated, or replaced with a vague adjective.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans carries every role. Introducing a second family breaks the system — the one exception is Geist Mono, scoped exclusively to reference codes.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth on a dark (charcoal) surface is conveyed with a blurred color glow, never a drop shadow. Drop shadows are reserved for light-surface elevation only.

dos: Do treat lime as a rare signal for "active, positive, or primary" — never a section background.
Do state every financial figure exactly, with a time window or sample size attached.
Do use the blurred lime glow for depth on charcoal surfaces instead of a drop shadow.
Do keep every corner rounded — buttons, cards, inputs, device frames, badges alike.
Do represent recognition/compliment tags with a small icon and a short label, not emoji.
Do pull every icon from lucide-react at stroke-width: 2, sized 16-20px, colored via currentColor.
donts: Don't introduce blue, or any generic corporate-SaaS palette, into primary chrome.
Don't use emoji as the primary vehicle for compliment tags, badges, or status — replace with a lucide-react icon + label.
Don't mix icon sets. Recreate any missing icon as a custom SVG in the same stroke style rather than pulling from a second library.
Don't let playful or gamified treatments into money-, security-, or settlement-related surfaces.
Don't use a sharp (0px) corner anywhere in the system.
Don't drop dashboard body text below the established 11-12px floor.
